# Module — Icons

**Path:** `src-tauri/icons/` · **57 generated files** · Parent: [[tauri-config]]

All generated by `npm run tauri icon app-icon.png` from the single source
image [[app-icon.png]]. None are hand-edited.

Individual notes are not created for these — see [[excluded]] for the
reasoning. This note is the complete inventory.

## Which platform uses what

### Windows — the only ones that matter here
| File | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `icon.ico` | **The build reads this.** Embedded as a Windows resource by [[build.rs]]. Referenced by `bundle.icon` in [[tauri.conf.json]] |
| `32x32.png`, `64x64.png`, `128x128.png`, `128x128@2x.png` | Generic raster sizes |
| `Square30x30Logo.png`, `Square44x44Logo.png`, `Square71x71Logo.png`, `Square89x89Logo.png`, `Square107x107Logo.png`, `Square142x142Logo.png`, `Square150x150Logo.png`, `Square284x284Logo.png`, `Square310x310Logo.png`, `StoreLogo.png` | MSIX / Microsoft Store tiles — unused, this project bundles NSIS only |
| `icon.png` | Master raster |

### macOS — unused
`icon.icns`. This is a Windows-only project.

### iOS — unused (18 files)
`ios/AppIcon-*.png` at 20/29/40/60/76/83.5 pt in @1x/@2x/@3x, plus
`AppIcon-512@2x.png`.

### Android — unused (16 files)
`android/mipmap-{m,h,x,xx,xxx}dpi/ic_launcher{,_round,_foreground}.png`,
`android/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml`,
`android/values/ic_launcher_background.xml`.

## Why the unused ones exist

`tauri icon` always emits the full cross-platform set. The mobile assets are a
by-product, not evidence of mobile support — see [[known-limitations]]. They
are harmless: nothing references them, and they are not bundled into the
Windows build.

## Regenerating

```powershell
npm run tauri icon path\to\square.png    # 1024×1024 recommended
```

Overwrites everything here. The current set derives from a placeholder
generated with System.Drawing — a green disc with a dark eighth-note glyph on a
near-black field, matching the `--accent` and `--bg` tokens in [[app.css]].
